notes.title: 🎉 Demo Released – Time to Saddle Up! 🎮🐎
notes.content:
A lot has changed over the past year and a half! Wild Horse Racing has been completely remade from the ground up, with all-new hand-drawn pixel art, a revamped soundtrack, responsive arcade-style physics, and tons of new gameplay features.

From upgradeable horseshoes and hoof management to multiple difficulty levels and a full-blown league system.

🏁 What’s in the Demo?
Race through four unique global locations across eight thrilling race days, with tracks playable in both regular and reversed directions.
Don’t miss the beginning of the epic story of [b]Centaur Barbarian[/b]!

🌎 What’s Coming in the Full Game?

Three competitive leagues: Bronze, Silver, and Gold

24 total race locations across the globe

Final chapters of Centaur Barbarian

Even faster horses and more chaotic races!

Ready to take the reins?

[b]Giddy Up![/b]
